compiled_state.description:
## Context

56% of sampled fixes add a new mechanism (lock, knob, env var, gate script, fixture, helper, flag) vs 30% pure logic fixes (R2S1) — the surface that produces future defect classes grows with every fix cycle. Confirmed genuinely new (12a: no unified detector exists); per-kind precedents prove detectability (check_config_reads.py AST detector, gen_env_registry.py). Pattern: the repo's own shrink-only complexity baseline (scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py, 644 lines: baseline JSON, --check fails on new>0/increased>0, --update-stale maintenance). Baseline keyed per (kind, name) — never a scalar sum — per the ESLint eslint-suppressions.json shape (12c), so one kind cannot be traded against another. 2026 grounding (12b): counter-pressure to general mechanism entropy (toggle-mining: deletions lag additions 13–35%), not an AI-specific premise.

## Approach

scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py detecting, per repo state (not per diff — state-diffing the baseline is simpler and equivalent): lock classes/lock files; REBAR_* env vars (reuse gen_env_registry's detector); rebar.toml keys (reuse the config schema); scripts/check_*.py + inline workflow run: steps; autouse fixtures; tests/_*.py helpers; feature flags. Baseline .github/mechanism-baseline.json keyed {kind: {name: 1}}; --check fails on any name present in the tree but absent from baseline (a NEW mechanism) unless the introducing change carries a declared justification consumed by the DET floor; removal of a name auto-shrinks via --update-stale (maintenance-only). Wire into make lint (and thus pre-commit + the Verified lane). CLI flags mirror the complexity baseline's real interface (--check / --update-stale — 12a corrected v3's "--lock").

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: the script detects all seven mechanism kinds with zero false positives on the current tree (baseline locked at introduction).
- [ ] AC2: --check exits non-zero when a new (kind,name) appears without justification; a seeded test proves each kind fires.
- [ ] AC3: mechanism removal passes and --update-stale drains the entry (shrink-only semantics identical to the complexity baseline).
- [ ] AC4: make lint runs the check; the justified-exception path is documented and itself greppable/countable.
- [ ] AC5: docs section explains the ratchet, its kinds, and the exception discipline.

## File impact

- scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py (new)
- .github/mechanism-baseline.json (new, locked at introduction)
- Makefile (lint wiring)
- tests/scripts/test_check_mechanism_delta.py (new)
- docs (contributor-facing ratchet note where the complexity ratchet is documented)
compiled_state.title: Deterministic mechanism-delta ratchet: check_mechanism_delta.py with per-(kind,name) shrink-only baseline
